about: Stage 3 knobs (plan claude-docs/stage3_plan_20261026, revision 1: Ethan answered 1A 2A 3A). Every number is set by the plan or copied from the Stage 0/1/2 fact tables (configs/control/stage0_facts.json, stage1_facts.json, configs/vision/stage2_facts.json) with its source; 3P measurements are under 'measured_3p'. Frozen at the tag stage3-freeze (3G); values Stage 3 measures go to configs/control/stage3_facts.json.

episode.note: plan section 2: 180 s and 3 closes per episode (decision 3A, 10-11); falls do not end it (stage0_facts getup.episode_rule). Delivered = 2 s after the end the target's centre is inside the tray's outer square (|dx|, |dy| < 0.15 m) and below 0.06 m (rim 0.01 + 0.05; microduck-lab world/arena.py:2010-2024 in_basket); strict = inside the inner square (0.15 - rim 0.006). Dev layouts = seeds 3000-3009 of scene/layout.py (configs/control/stage3_layouts.json); the formal seeds 1000-1019 are never run in Stage 3

search.note: plan 3 SPIN and LOOK. Spin: head 0.15 (stage2.json deploy.head, the middle of the trained 0-0.3 search range; turning camera pitch 10.9 deg, inside the 0-17.2 deg of the training data), window view, wz +0.8 (stage1.json approach.turn_wz_radps; +0.5 does not turn from cold, stage0_facts turn_steady_radps_mac_H1), 380 deg on odometry, a target in >= spin_hits frames ends the spin. Spin frames give bearings (the frame trails robot.state by 30-40 ms, about 2 deg at 0.9 rad/s), so their ground points only seed a candidate: they enter the sighting table at spin_weight and cluster within cluster_m + spin_cluster_per_m x distance. Look: H0 standing (pitch 13.4 deg, also inside 0-17.2), settle 1 s and 5 frames (stage1.json inching.settle_s, frames), turn first only if the candidate is more than look_turn_tol_deg off (the window sees +-22.5 deg); the target in >= 3 of 5 frames within look_match_m of the candidate and <= confirm_m away = confirmed (stage2_facts confirm_distance.zero_confusion_m 1.6); a distractor class there in >= 3 frames = a distractor spot; max_misses looks without the target drop the candidate. A candidate nearer than look_near_m goes to the B segment without a look: the window's bottom edge is about 0.33 m from the trunk at H0 standing (Mac 3ab 2026-10-26: four looks at a target 0.26 m away saw nothing). Two empty spins (the second from the nearest relocate spot at least relocate_min_m away) = search_fail. Detections beyond max_range_m are ignored (stage2_facts search_radius 1.8 m)

goto.head: H0
goto.note: plan 3 GOTO: H0 at vx 0.3 (stage0_facts forward_steady_mps_mac H0: 0.3 -> 0.224 m/s) with the B segment's heading PI and turns (stage1.json approach), legs of min(distance to the B start, leg_max_m), a look after each leg, until the target is within b_start_m (+ tol) = the B segment's start (stage0_facts segment_head_pose B 0.6-0.25 m). The B start is on the side the robot comes from unless a known toy is within corridor_m of the straight line from there to the target

route.note: plan 3 GOTO and CARRY: routes stay clear_m from known toys and tray_inflate_m outside the tray, and keep the trunk keep_in_m from the walls (toys are >= 0.25 m from the walls, stage1.json layout.wall_clear_m). A ToF stop adds an obstacle of tof_obstacle_m at the stop point; if those leave CARRY no route to any side they are dropped (every stop is a wall, already in keep_in_m; after a fall their points are wrong), and with still none the nearest side is walked to straight. Plan fallback: clear_m 0.15 -> 0.2 if non-target toys get pushed

carry.head: H1
carry.note: plan 3 CARRY: H1 at 0.25 m/s (stage1_facts carry_1g_mac.stage3_default; 9/9, 0 falls, 0 drops; drift 1-5 cm per 0.5 m), to the staging point staging_m from the tray centre on the side's normal (lab aim_range 0.42 and basket_normal); +x is not used (0.2 m between tray and wall); the side with the shortest route whose lane (staging point -> tray edge, lane_half_m each side) holds no known toy. arrive_m: close enough to square up

tray_look.head: H1
tray_look.note: plan 3 TRAY_LOOK: H1 standing at the staging point (near rim about 0.3 m ahead), 5 frames letterboxed; tray box bottom = near rim (stage1.json arena.tray rim_height_m 0.01); only a tray box within accept_m of the odometry estimate (plan risk table: 47 tray boxes on untrayed ground in 2E); turn first if the centre is more than turn_tol_deg off
tray_look.note_fall: 3D cloud pre-run: a fall throws the odometry 0.3-0.4 m off (contact odometry while tumbling), so the robot reaches a wrong staging point and the real tray box (conf 0.95 in 5/5 frames) fell outside accept_m. After a fall the window is accept_after_fall_m, with at least min_frames_after_fall frames; a tray measured by YOLO re-anchors the field position (the tray is a fixed landmark). After a fall, a re-anchor larger than carry.arrive_m sends the robot back to CARRY (looking at the tray from off its normal ranged it 4-6 cm short); otherwise a tray more than range_tol_m beyond staging_m is walked up to and looked at again; at most max_moves of either
tray_look.note_scan: scan_after_fall_deg: cloud 3D, after two falls the staging point was 0.4 m off and the tray 88 deg to the right, outside the picture (fovy 45 deg across the upright 360 px, so +-22.5 deg), and the toy was dropped on odometry. With the pose in doubt and no tray box, the robot turns these steps in turn (looking at +45, +90, -45, -90 deg from where it stood, +-112 deg in all) and looks again; the first tray box ends the scan

recover.note: RECOVER after the toy came out of the beak: look at H2 first (camera 0.98 rad down, the ground from about 8 cm ahead of the trunk; stage0_facts head_geometry_mac), then H1 (from about 12 cm); cloud 3D: a toy dropped 6 cm ahead was invisible at H1. Seen nearer than backoff_below_m (the park point 8 cm + a margin): back off one retreat pulse (B10, about 10 cm) so the B segment can aim, then APPROACH; not seen: back off one pulse and look again (looks in all; cloud 3D: a toy 5 cm ahead, under the beak, is seen by neither head), then forget the pick spot and search afresh

drop.head: H0
drop.note: plan 3 DROP and 3C: H0 (tip 7.9 cm ahead, 0.7 cm more than H1; stage0_facts head_geometry_mac), walk blind until the trunk is d_m from the tray centre, stand 1 s (stopping from 0.3 m/s settles in 0.7-1.0 s, stage0_facts stop_from_0.3mps_mac), open 0.6 s (lab drop_s), close, end (no back-off). d_m = the lab's 0.22 rounded to the sweep's middle until 3C picks one of d_sweep_m. vx 0.3 at H0 because the coast the walk allows for (stage1.json approach.walk_slide_m 0.04) was measured from 0.3 (3.9 cm at H0)

fall.note: plan 3 FALLEN: the fall guard zeroes the move (stage1_facts fall_guard_mac 0.34-0.35 s); wait for velstand to stand (stage0_facts getup: Mac max 4.82 s), then settle. Holding by the mouth angle (stage1.json grasp.held_threshold_deg) -> CARRY; dropped in the fall -> look at the feet (H1), else re-search

tof.note: plan 3D: a zone whose return is >= min_height_m above the floor and <= stop_range_m from the trunk axis, ignoring slant ranges < self_blind_m (the beak and a held toy), in `frames` consecutive frames (15 Hz) = stop, back off (stage1_facts pulses_mac B10), route around the stop point. stop_range_m 0.22: stopping from 0.3 m/s slides 3.9-4.9 cm (stage0_facts stop_from_0.3mps_mac), so the trunk ends about 0.16 m from a wall, the toes about 0.12 m; the stop is only checked while a walk is commanded, and walks end walk_slide_m (4 cm) before their goal, so a route ending at the keep-in line (0.22 m) does not trip it. self_blind_m 0.08 (3P, was the lab's hold_blind_m 0.12): the sensor sits 6.5 cm (head 0) to 8.5 cm (H1) ahead of the trunk and no zone ever returned from the beak or a held toy (m_tof), while at 0.12 a wall only counted from 0.22 down to about 0.19 m, 2 frames at 0.224 m/s; 3D measures it
tof.note_tilt: max_tilt_deg: cloud 3D false stop mid-fall (a return 0.12 m behind the trunk, 0.26 m up, before safety.fallen was set); zones count only ahead of the trunk and only while it is within 20 deg of upright (cloud 3e upright trunk tilt p99 4 deg, max 16 deg)

camera.note: the frame's moment = its first byte minus stream_lag_s (Mac and board stream); 3P/3A measure the bearing error of spin frames and decide whether to set it. Mac 3P 2026-10-26: 118 ms late (spin bearing p50 4.8 deg), with frames drawn on the physics thread and sent on their own 15 Hz clock. Mac 3p rerun 2026-10-27 (camera on a worker, each frame sent when drawn, stream_lag_s 0): 71 ms late (39 spin boxes, mean +3.09 deg at 0.757 rad/s, |err| p50 3.07 deg), about the Mac's draw time (p50 41 ms) plus the UYVY packing and the send, so 0.07. measure.score_spin reports what is left after it (lag_s_from_frame_err); the board's 3F stream adds the Ethernet hop and is read there

detector.note: the frozen Stage 2 models (PR #2, configs/vision/stage2_facts.json); classes, conf 0.25, iou 0.45 and the window margin come from configs/vision/stage2.json. Mac runs use cpu (split FP32 ONNX); the board closed loop uses int8 (stage2_facts precision_choice)

plane_z_m.note: height of the plane a box centre is cut with: half the toy's collision box height (scene/toys.py rest_z; tests/test_stage3_world.py checks them against the catalogue); for the tray the plane of its box's bottom edge, where the near rim meets the floor (3P: z 0 lands 0.7 cm short of the rim on average over 3 oracle boxes, the rim top 0.01 lands 1.8 cm short)

measured_3p.where: cloud twin (MuJoCo 3.10 + robotd s2 debug, frames rendered on request), run 20261026T081237Z_s33p_s2; the Mac repeats them in its first batch (3p) and its numbers replace these
measured_3p.view_held_toy: at the x- staging point with a held toy and head H1 the toy is below the picture's lower edge (no segmentation pixels, bus/henry/ketchup); it covers 0 % of the tray box; YOLO finds the tray in 3/3 frames for each toy
measured_3p.tof_staging: 0 stop frames at the staging point (H0 and H1, with and without a toy): the tray rim (1 cm) is below min_height_m, the held toy and the beak are inside self_blind_m
measured_3p.tof_wall: facing a wall: 0.20 m stops at H0 / H1 / search head (nearest return 0.191 m), 0.30 and 0.50 m do not; open field 0 stops
measured_3p.drop_geometry: with the trunk d from the tray centre the toy leaves the beak d - 0.09 m short of the centre (H0) and the toes are d - 0.034 m from it; the near rim is 0.15 m from the centre, so d 0.19 / 0.21 / 0.23 lands the toy 5 / 3 / 1 cm inside the 0.15 m judge square with the toes 0.6 / 2.6 / 4.6 cm outside the rim: 3C's sweep is the whole usable window. First cloud episode: d 0.2015 m, toy 12.2 cm short of the centre (2.8 cm inside)
measured_3p.spin_note: pairing a spin frame with the robot.state nearest its moment leaves 0.7 deg (p50), 2.5 deg (p90): stream_lag_s stays 0 for the cloud's probe frames; the receipt-time error (18 deg) is the cloud's render time and shows why the frame's own moment is used. The Mac's stream frames: 71 ms late in the 3p rerun, see camera.stream_lag_s
measured_3p.tof_pose_trunk: ToF in the trunk frame: head 0 at [0.0645, 0.0225, 0.1269] facing straight ahead; H1 at [0.0846, 0.0218, 0.0777] pitched 42 deg down
measured_3p.tray_bottom_edge: the oracle tray box's bottom row, cut with z = 0, lands 0.7 cm short of the near rim on average (3 views: -0.7, +0.8, -2.3 cm), with z = 0.01 (the rim top) 1.8 cm short: plane_z_m.tray = 0. H1 at the staging point sees +-12 cm sideways at the near rim, so the 30 cm tray box is cut at both sides
